question: For Rahul Gandhi, return the graph-recorded age, gender, profession, education, aliases, number of sons, number of daughters, and source-document date, keeping missing values distinct from zero.
For Narendra Modi, return recorded age, education, profession, terms, council section, and special responsibilities.
Which Party node is Rahul Gandhi connected to through MEMBER_OF?
Show the CriminalCase records linked to Rahul Gandhi, with each case's recorded status, court, FIR number, and case number.
Show BJP MLAs with recorded total assets above 500000000, including their recorded liabilities and movable and immovable assets.
What is the average recorded age and number of MLAs by party for constituencies in Gujarat? Use distinct MLAs and return the top 10 groups.
Among BJP and INC MLAs representing constituencies in Gujarat, compare average total assets, movable assets, immovable assets, and liabilities by party.
For people grouped by party, calculate average recorded number of sons and daughters and count how many records have both values present.
For each party, count distinct MLAs and distinct CriminalCase nodes by the case status recorded in Neo4j.
Which Section codes occur most often among CriminalCase nodes linked to BJP MLAs? Return distinct case counts, sorted descending, limited to 10.
For each Ministry portfolio_type and party, count distinct people holding a portfolio and count distinct holders with a linked case.
By party, count distinct MLAs with non-null age, education, profession, total assets, liabilities, and criminal_case_count.
Group MLAs into age bands under 40, 40 to 59, and 60 or older, and report counts by party. Ignore records with unknown age.
Show BJP MLA-to-case-to-Section paths where the Section code contains 420, including the case's recorded status.
Show INC MLAs connected through REPRESENTS to an AssemblyConstituency in Delhi, and include the State node when linked.
For each party among Gujarat MLAs, calculate MLA count, average total assets, average liabilities, count of distinct MLAs linked to at least one case, and distinct case count.
For BJP and INC MLAs, group by State and report distinct MLA count, distinct linked case count, and average age; return the 10 largest groups.
For each Section code and recorded case status, count distinct cases linked to MLAs, and show the ten largest section-status groups.
Compare by party the average stored criminal_case_count property with the average number of distinct CriminalCase nodes reached through FACES for MLAs.
For each party and Ministry portfolio_type, count distinct portfolio holders, distinct linked criminal cases, and distinct Section codes reached from those cases.
By party and election_year, count MLAs and report the latest available source_document_date; do not treat missing dates as current.
Among MLAs with recorded nSons and nDaughters, compare by party the average family counts, average assets, and number of records with non-null values.
Trace BJP through MEMBER_OF to MLA, then FACES to CriminalCase, then UNDER to Section; return case number, status, court, and Section code.
Trace INC membership to MLAs, their represented AssemblyConstituencies, and the State for seats in Gujarat.
Show people connected to BJP who hold Ministry portfolios, including the HOLDS_PORTFOLIO role and Ministry portfolio_type.
Compare BJP and INC by State using distinct MLA counts, mean age, median total_assets if supported by Cypher, case prevalence, distinct linked case counts, and the top Section code.
For every party, rank the top five Section codes by distinct linked MLA count, split by recorded CriminalCase.status, and include total distinct cases.
By node label, report node counts and the number and percentage with source_document_date; return the latest date available per label.
For Gujarat MLAs by party, return the five largest recorded total_assets values with MLA name, liabilities, and constituency; exclude null asset values.
For BJP and INC MLAs grouped by State and recorded case status, report distinct affected MLAs, cases per affected MLA, and average total_assets.

Find BJP MLAs represented in Gujarat who are linked to cases under Sections containing 120B; show the party-person-constituency-state-case-section evidence path, and keep the stored arrows in the correct direction.
Show BJP members who hold a Ministry portfolio and are also linked to a CriminalCase, returning the membership path and the separate portfolio and case links with their stored properties.
Find a Person whose name, MyNeta name, or aliases contain Rahul Gandhi; show their party link and any FACES-linked cases without treating the link as guilt.
For each party, compare average age, assets, and liabilities while also returning a separate non-null denominator for each measure.
Show BJP MLA paths to cases whose recorded status contains Pending and return case_no, fir_no, court, charges_framed, ipc_sections, and Section codes where available.
List current Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha MPs by party, State, age, affidavit assets, and linked cases; do not infer MPs from Person nodes.
Compare the wives of BJP and INC MLAs by profession, assets, and party; report unsupported if spouse relationships are not represented.
Which politicians currently hold office as of today, grouped by party and State? Require a verified as-of date, otherwise report unsupported.
For each party and State, reconcile MLA counts from MEMBER_OF plus REPRESENTS with distinct case counts through FACES and UNDER, and report distinct Section counts; avoid join multiplication.

For Gujarat BJP and INC MLAs, compare case burden quartiles with total_assets and liabilities, using distinct MLAs and cases, excluding unknown numeric values, and returning sample counts for every group.
